run_dreambooth_training: run dreambooth fine-tuning on a pretrained stable diffusion model with instance images and prompts
create_dreambooth_dataset: create a DreamBoothDataset that prepares instance and class images with tokenized prompts for model training
generate_class_images: generate class images with prior preservation loss using a diffusion pipeline and class prompt
validate_dreambooth_model: validate a trained dreambooth model by generating images from a validation prompt and logging to tensorboard or wandb
save_dreambooth_model_card: save a model card markdown file with example images, base model info, and training metadata for a dreambooth model
